entities.name: Feather
entities.description: A Boros Firemane angel, Agrus Kos's partner, who became Boros Guildmaster and was later deposed.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Feather's partner, who freed her wings; his death brought her back.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of angels and soldiers that Feather led.

entities.name: League of Wojek
entities.description: The law-enforcement body in which Feather served to work off a holy debt.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: An angel created by Feather who challenged her rule.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: His ghost army killed the Boros angels.

entities.name: Pivlic
entities.description: Managed Feather's salary as a wojek.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: Freed Feather in a secretive raid.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: An airship Feather helped build and later searched for.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle in which Feather flew with Aurelia's Firemanes.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: The agency to which Feather is the Boros liaison.

events.summary: Feather is placed in the League of Wojek to work off a holy debt, her wings bound.
events.quote: Feather was placed in the League of Wojek to work off a holy debt, and her wings were bound

events.summary: After the Decamillennial, Kos frees her wings and she vanishes looking for the Parhelion.
events.quote: Kos freed her wings and she vanished, looking for the missing Parhelion

events.summary: Feather returns on sensing Kos's death and is chosen as a pallbearer.
events.quote: She reappeared when she sensed Kos's death.

events.summary: Feather submits for arrest during the Dissension, revealing she is the last surviving Boros angel; later she is named Boros Guildmaster.
events.quote: she was named as the Boros Guildmaster

events.summary: Aurelia challenges Feather's rule and Feather is imprisoned.
events.quote: Feather was imprisoned until her final fate could be decided.

events.summary: Krenko frees Feather in a secretive raid.
events.quote: Feather was freed, however, during a secretive raid performed by Krenko .

events.summary: During the War of the Spark Feather flies alongside Aurelia's Firemanes.
events.quote: she was allowed to fly alongside Aurelia's Firemanes

relations.quote: who spent much time as Agrus Kos 's partner

relations.note: Aurelia is one of her creations.

relations.quote: Her tenure as Guildmaster was challenged by Aurelia
she was named as the Boros Guildmaster
